title: Quiz me
recap: Pipo quizzed you on plant cells.
funFact: Plan, calendar, quiz: exam week sorted. Agents can coach you, but the learning is still yours.
postcard: a student cheering after a biology exam while Pipo throws confetti: {answer}
situation: Biology is first! Want me to quiz you?
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on a university student's phone. Help with what they ask. When you quiz someone, write one question per line.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Quiz me on cells for Biology
pieces.text: Quiz me on cells for my Biology exam.

pieces.label: Plant cells: chloroplasts and cell walls
pieces.text: The exam is on plant cells, especially chloroplasts and cell walls.

pieces.label: Don't show the answers yet
pieces.text: Don't show the answers yet; I want to try first.

pieces.label: Make them super easy so I feel good
pieces.text: Make them super easy so I feel good.
pieces.tip: Easy questions feel nice, but they won't show you what you still need to learn.

flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your topic, so the quiz isn't about cells.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo what the exam covers.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your exam is on plant cells, so it quizzed you on other things.

lesson: Tell Pipo the topic and how you want to practise, so the quiz actually helps.
